observations.claim: A field-symbol code describes a pictorial/conventional motif distinct from script signs. One side has one combined field-symbol description or none; several animals on one side can form one composite category.

Object shape may itself supply the field-symbol category on text-bearing sides; motif-only sides are also coded. Blank sides are not numbered. Inscribed sides precede motif-only sides. Side ordering is provisional and may use textual evidence.
Each reference denotes one inscribed object/text, possibly spanning several sides and lines. Line metadata repeats the side association; lines are not independent iconographic objects.
Reference1001-1905 is a Mohenjodaro source block from MIC volumeIII. No inspected rule proves motif sorting within that block or chronological ordering.
TableV associates signs and motifs across the entire object, including across different sides; it excludes signs without an associated motif.

release4_audit.interpretation: No confirmed contrasting specific animal class. The sole absent-side code is on an object with unicorn on its other side; code35 is uncertainty, not a distinct identified bull category.
